programs.title: Mini Lessons: Science Primary
programs.desc: In this lesson, you will learn what happens when we combine different materials to make a new mixture or substance. Mrs Carmeli will show you some simple investigations, to determine which materials are best for making slime.

programs.title: btn
programs.desc: BTN is a high-energy, fun way for Upper Primary and Secondary students to learn about current issues and events in their world. Each program is built around major news stories of the week.

programs.title: The Slow Mo Guys' Big Adventures
programs.desc: How fast can a space rocket travel? The Slow Mo Guys find out with their special cameras.

programs.title: Elevator Pitch
programs.desc: Why do astronauts on the International Space Station age more slowly than us here on the ground? Rad Yeo gives astrophysicist Dr Devika Kamath two Earth minutes to untangle the science.

programs.title: BtN Newsbreak
programs.desc: Find out what's going on in the world with a news bulletin designed for children, featuring stories that are relevant and easy to understand.

programs.title: Phil Spencer: Secret Agent Specials
programs.desc: Phil's in Warrington, and Pauline and Alan Jacks want to downsize but have had no interest in their three bed property. Just a mile away, Colin Brunold is hoping his four bed family home will sell itself.
